label: BoardUI-style Overview
desc: A shop dashboard built from the BoardUI-style components with six working views: an overview (period switch, four KPI cards with info tips, revenue and orders charts against last year, recent customers), a customers table with sort, filters, selection and edit, reports with CSV export, a notification inbox shared with the bell, support and settings forms. The sidebar collapses to a rail and the layout follows its container.
use: Shop, SaaS or subscription admin home: revenue, orders, customers, notifications.
